name: Staff of Hope
body:
Price 29,700 gp; Aura moderate enchantment; CL 9; Weight 5 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This staff is made of a golden honey wood and feels comfortable in heft and grip. It allows use of the following spells:

ray of hope (1 charge)
good hope (2 charges)
joyous laugh (2 charges)

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 14,850 gp; Feats Craft Staff; Spells good hope, joyous laugh, ray of hope
